retry.description:
Elk E27 couldn't finish upgrading from the older version (0.1), and nothing was changed. Leftover entities that already use the new names ({count}):{conflicts}

Remove the leftover entities that block the upgrade of this Elk E27 entry by hand under Settings → Devices & services → Entities, or, if another loaded Elk E27 entry provides them, delete or disable that entry under Settings → Devices & services. Then select **Submit** to retry the upgrade.

Select **Submit** to delete the listed entities and retry the upgrade. This removes their history link, so take a backup first. To keep them, close this and delete or rename them yourself under Settings → Devices & services → Entities.

alarm_arm_automatic.name: Arm automatic
alarm_arm_automatic.description: Arms Elk E27 areas from automations, such as geofence- or occupancy-based arming when everyone leaves. Open (faulted) zones in each targeted area are bypassed before arming; zones in other areas are not changed. It cancels auto-stay and the exit delay so the area arms immediately. Refusals are never retried; if a bypass or the arm is refused, the area is not armed and the bypasses it made are undone. If the arm result is unknown (for example a timeout), the bypasses are left in place and you are told to check the panel. An area that is already armed is left unchanged. A pending disarm of the area pauses a running call before its next command; if the panel accepts the disarm, the call is cancelled, sends nothing more and does not roll back.

code.name: Code
code.description: Numeric alarm user code used to arm the area.

zone_bypass.name: Bypass zone
zone_bypass.description: Bypasses Elk E27 zones so they are ignored while the area is armed, or removes the bypass. Disarming an armed area clears all bypasses; disarming an area that is already disarmed does not.

code.description: Numeric alarm user code used to bypass the zone.
